text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction/resumption over the new assertion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative topic that holds the revealed content open

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a connector over the whole relative-nominal assertion. It carries the reward discourse of 35:30 into a fresh revelation warrant, without forcing the relation to mean only sequence or only cause. The analytical split also lets the reader see the connector before {{ar:ٱلَّذِىٓ}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) starts the new topic.

topics.headline: resumptive proof link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 35:31 as continuing the prior reward claim while launching a new warrant around revelation.
topics.reason: QAC treats the particle as a conjunction/resumption before a full nominal assertion, and the CRITICAL rows preserve both continuity with 35:30 and fresh proof-unit force.

topics.headline: visible connector split
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the opening connector as its own formal mechanism instead of losing it inside the following relative word.
topics.reason: The bundle splits the prefixed connector as word 1, making its clause-level scope available for analysis.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun that holds the revealed content as the topic
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِىٓ}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) makes the revealed content a definite relative topic before it is named by status. The listener must pass through {{ar:أَوْحَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:awḥaynā}}), {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}), and {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) before {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) resumes the topic and {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}) declares its identity. Its separate form after the opening connector keeps the topic-head clear rather than blurred into the conjunction.

topics.headline: delayed relative topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah identify the revealed thing by source and recipient before declaring it to be the truth.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the object of the revelation verb and is later resumed by the pronoun before the truth predicate.

topics.headline: held-open relative form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the relative head as an audible and visible topic marker, not a swallowed part of the opening connector.
topics.reason: The prefixed connector is analyzed separately, and the surface length of the relative pronoun helps hold the topic open until the resumption.

words.gloss_range: completed Form IV divine disclosure directed to a recipient
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes hidden signal and revelation; local Form IV narrows it to directed Book-bearing disclosure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: named divine subject of the warrant clause

words.prose: {{ar:أَوْحَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:awḥaynā}}) is the first finite action and presents revelation as a completed divine act. Its first-person plural morphology carries the speaker before the explicit divine name appears at {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}), while Form IV and {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) make the disclosure directed to an endpoint. The same verb keeps roles separated: divine speaker, revealed relative object, prophetic recipient, and Book-source do not collapse into one vague revelation idea. The broader waḥy range of hidden signal and inspiration is narrowed here to Book-bearing disclosure: a controlled communication from the Book-domain, not mutual secret exchange or ordinary human discovery.

topics.headline: completed divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that revelation is already a completed divine act before the truth predicate is spoken.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural verb encodes divine agency compactly, with the named divine subject arriving only in the final warrant clause.

topics.headline: directed revelation channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices revelation as targeted communication to the addressee, while the local Form IV blocks mutual or merely instinctive signaling as the controlling sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports hidden directed communication, and Form IV plus the recipient phrase selects one-directional divine disclosure here.

topics.headline: agent object recipient source separated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees agent, revealed object, recipient, and Book-source held apart instead of collapsed into one vague revelation idea.
topics.reason: The local syntax makes the relative pronoun the object, the second-person phrase the recipient, and the Book phrase the source-domain.

topics.headline: Book-bearing disclosure arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this waḥy instance narrowed against wider usage to Book-bearing disclosure that begins the ayah’s warrant chain.
topics.reason: Rows comparing 16:68 and 42:51 show broader waḥy range, but the local Book phrase and confirmation chain narrow the ayah to textual revelation.

topics.headline: first action and measured handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the proof begin with disclosure and then hand off to the addressee before source and truth are named.
topics.reason: The verb is the first finite action, and its extended ending before the recipient phrase supports the act-to-addressee movement.

words.gloss_range: goal preposition plus second-person suffix marking the prophetic endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) marks the directed endpoint of the revelation act. The attached second-person suffix makes the route specific to one addressee, while the placement before {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) lets reception be fixed before textual provenance is supplied.

topics.headline: specific recipient endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is the endpoint of delivery, not the source or the object of what is revealed.
topics.reason: The preposition with second-person suffix is the syntactically forced recipient complement of the revelation verb.

topics.headline: recipient before source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah establish the delivery path before naming the Book-domain from which the revealed content comes.
topics.reason: The recipient phrase precedes the Book-source phrase within the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: source, partitive, or explanatory preposition before the Book phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) opens the Book phrase without flattening it to one relation. It can mark source, partitive relation, or explanation, so the revealed item remains from within or from the authority of {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}). Because this phrase arrives before {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}), provenance is heard before identity-status.

topics.headline: source-partitive polyvalence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book is both provenance and authoritative domain, not a detached title after the fact.
topics.reason: QAC licenses source, partitive, or explanatory force before the definite Book, and no guardrail forces a single narrower value.

topics.headline: provenance before truth identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears textual provenance before the ayah declares the revealed item to be the truth.
topics.reason: The preposition binds into the definite Book phrase immediately before the pronoun-predicate hinge.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive Book as source-domain and recognized textual authority
words.root_gloss_range: writing, prescription, and joining/binding range; local noun selects fixed textual authority
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) is governed by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}), so it supplies source-domain rather than serving as the predicate; {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}) will take that identity role. Its definite singular form invokes a recognized textual authority. The root pressure of writing, prescription, and stitching or joining is narrowed locally into a fixed, binding register from which the revealed truth comes, and the same Book thread links recitation, truth, and inheritance across 35:29, 35:31, and 35:32.

topics.headline: governed definite source-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Book as the recognized source-domain, not as a second predicate competing with the truth claim.
topics.reason: The genitive definite noun is governed by the preceding preposition, while the truth predicate is licensed later after the resumptive pronoun.

topics.headline: fixed binding record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book is not loose speech but a fixed and binding textual register; the sewing/writing range is kept as binding pressure, not as a different local referent.
topics.reason: The root family supports writing, prescription, and joining, but the local definite noun selects recognized textual authority.

topics.headline: Book truth confirmation arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Book phrase as part of a broader scriptural arc: Book-source leads to truth and confirmation, then to inheritance in 35:32.
topics.reason: Rows point to Book with truth and confirmation in 2:2 and 5:48 and to the same-surah movement from recitation in 35:29 to inheritance in 35:32.

topics.headline: provenance before hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authority is supplied before evaluation: the text comes from the Book-domain before it is called the truth.
topics.reason: The Book phrase sits immediately before the pronoun hinge and after the revelation verb, binding hidden disclosure to fixed textual source.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun resuming the relative topic and separating the predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) visibly resumes the long relative topic and turns the clause from revelation-event to identity claim. Because the explicit pronoun stands before {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}), the truth word is not heard as a loose descriptive continuation of the Book phrase but as the predicate of the revealed content. The short pronoun-to-predicate turn also gives the hinge an audible compact cadence.

topics.headline: resumptive identity hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural pivot where narrated revelation becomes an identity claim.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun resumes the relative subject and separates it from the definite truth predicate.

topics.headline: audible compact turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a short pronoun-to-predicate turn that makes the identity hinge perceptible.
topics.reason: The detached pronoun has its own word-shape before the heavier predicate follows.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative truth predicate identifying the revealed item
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, right, and due claim; local predicate selects established binding truth
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}) is the definite nominative predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), so the revealed content is identified as the established truth, not merely described as one true item. The root range of reality, right, and due claim makes this truth binding as well as factual. Its position before {{ar:مُصَدِّقًۭا}} ({{tr:muṣaddiqan}}) matters: the ayah first asserts what the revelation is, then states what it does by confirming what stands before it. The doubled final consonant gives the predicate a tight landing that suits the fixity claim.

topics.headline: definite truth identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the revealed item is identified as the truth itself, not merely given a descriptive quality.
topics.reason: The definite nominative predicate after the resumptive pronoun creates identity predication.

topics.headline: binding rightful truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels truth as reality with rightful claim; the broader entitlement range strengthens the predicate without replacing the local sense.
topics.reason: The root family carries truth, right, and due claim, while the local abstract predicate selects established binding truth.

topics.headline: truth before confirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ontology before operation: the revelation is first true in itself, then confirming toward another field.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from Book-source to truth identity to confirming participle, with parallels in 2:147 and 3:3 and same-surah truth pressure in 35:5 and 35:24.

topics.headline: firm predicate landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the predicate land firmly, matching the semantic force of fixed truth.
topics.reason: The definite abstract noun and tightened consonantal landing support the predicate as a stable status rather than an event of proving.

words.gloss_range: accusative active participle of confirmation attached as circumstantial state
words.root_gloss_range: truthfulness and verification range; local Form II participle selects active authentication

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: adverbial construct head of the before-it phrase
dual possessed hand idiom completing the foreground phrase

words.prose: {{ar:مُصَدِّقًۭا}} ({{tr:muṣaddiqan}}) is an accusative circumstantial active participle, so confirmation accompanies the truth claim rather than becoming a second independent predicate. Its Form II shape makes truth transitive: the revealed truth actively authenticates the prior field named through {{ar:لِّمَا}} ({{tr:limā}}) {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) {{ar:يَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:yadayhi}}). This compresses the Book-truth-confirmation pattern seen at 3:3 and 5:48, while preserving the following pronoun pressure; identity is fixed first, then confirmation reaches outward.

topics.headline: circumstantial confirming state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices confirmation as a state accompanying the revealed truth, not as a detached second assertion.
topics.reason: The accusative active participle is licensed as a ḥāl linked to the truth predicate.

topics.headline: active verification reach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the truthfulness root become active authentication; the broader sincerity range is narrowed to verifying relation here.
topics.reason: Form II and the lām complement make the participle actively confirm a specified domain.

topics.headline: scriptural continuity formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the local phrase compress a familiar Book-truth-confirmation pattern without flattening the pronoun pressure that follows.
topics.reason: Rows point to 3:3 and 5:48 for Book, truth, and confirmation, while the local structure keeps the following suffix compact and charged.

topics.headline: from identity to operation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from what the revelation is to what it does.
topics.reason: The participle follows the truth predicate and opens the reach completed by the following object phrase.

words.gloss_range: lām plus mā object-domain of confirmation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: adverbial construct head of the before-it phrase
dual possessed hand idiom completing the foreground phrase

words.prose: {{ar:لِّمَا}} ({{tr:limā}}) gives {{ar:مُصَدِّقًۭا}} ({{tr:muṣaddiqan}}) a directed object-domain. The lām prevents confirmation from remaining an internal quality, while mā keeps the confirmed field open until {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) {{ar:يَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:yadayhi}}) locates it. The fused surface lets governance and broad reference be heard together.

topics.headline: directed object-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that confirmation has a target field, not just an abstract verifying quality.
topics.reason: The lām-governed complement is syntactically forced after the active participle.

topics.headline: open referent resolved by idiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches the object move from broad whatness into a spatial-temporal before-it field.
topics.reason: The mā keeps the referent open until the following before-it idiom supplies orientation.

topics.headline: fused governance and reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the prepositional governance and open reference as one compact object unit.
topics.reason: The written unit fuses lām and mā while preserving both syntactic governance and referential openness.

words.gloss_range: adverbial construct head of the before-it idiom
words.root_gloss_range: separation, relation, and clarity range; local construct makes a relational confirmation arena

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: dual possessed hand idiom completing the foreground phrase

words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) is not a simple particle here; it is an adverbial construct head that governs {{ar:يَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:yadayhi}}). It turns the open object from {{ar:لِّمَا}} ({{tr:limā}}) into a relational foreground before the revealed truth. The separation-and-clarity root pressure survives as a local payoff: the confirmed field is distinct enough to be recognized and close enough to be held in relation, though the ayah does not switch to a separate clarifying verb. The clarity echo remains concrete against 16:44 and 12:1, where explanation and a clear Book frame nearby proof language.

topics.headline: adverbial construct head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the before-it phrase built syntactically, with the interval word governing the dual hand noun.
topics.reason: The word functions as an adverbial noun in construct with the following genitive dual.

topics.headline: clarifying between-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices confirmation happening in a space of distinction and relation; the clarity branch colors the idiom without making a separate explaining action local.
topics.reason: The root supports separation and clarity, while the local noun remains a static interval head rather than a Form II clarifying verb.

topics.headline: idiom locates confirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the broad object of confirmation close into an anterior textual field.
topics.reason: The sequence from the open object to the before-it idiom turns confirmation toward precedence, presence, and foreground.

topics.headline: proof-field echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the local between-word participate in the surah’s clarity field and in broader Book-clarity language.
topics.reason: Rows cite clarification and Book-clarity contexts at 16:44 and 12:1, while the local ayah makes clarity operate through confirmation.

words.gloss_range: dual possessed hand noun completing the before-it idiom
words.root_gloss_range: hand, power, possession, support, and forefront; local dual idiom selects textual foreground and reach
words.prose: {{ar:يَدَيْهِ}} ({{tr:yadayhi}}) completes the construct idiom with a dual possessed hand-form. The suffix routes the phrase back toward the revealed item or Book-domain, keeping both antecedents near rather than forcing a repeated noun. The hand range is narrowed into textual foreground and operative reach: prior scripture stands before the confirming revelation as a reachable, present field, not as literal anatomy. The confirmation idiom is recognizable in 2:97 and 5:48, where authentication reaches what stands before the revealed text.

topics.headline: dual possessed idiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees concrete two-hand morphology turned into the standard before-it textual idiom.
topics.reason: The dual genitive form is the construct complement of the interval word and supplies the idiomatic foreground relation.

topics.headline: compact antecedent pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix keeps the revealed item and the Book-domain both close, so confirmation is not flattened to a single repeated title.
topics.reason: The third-person suffix can route through the revealed content or Book-domain, preserving the local pressure of compact reference.

topics.headline: hand as reach and presence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels prior scripture as present and reachable before the confirming revelation, while the local idiom blocks literal anatomical reading as the main sense.
topics.reason: The root range includes hand, power, possession, support, and forefront, narrowed here to textual foreground and operative reach.

topics.headline: confirmation formula spatialized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the confirmation formula as spatialized: authentication reaches what stands before the revealed text.
topics.reason: Rows cite 2:97 and 5:48 for the before-it idiom in confirmation contexts, and the local phrase closes the participle’s reach.

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulling particle opening the final warrant clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic lām on the first predicate

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns from the Book-truth-confirmation chain into the final warrant clause. It names the clause as emphatic explanation: the truth and confirmation just asserted are grounded in Allah’s knowledge of His servants. Its force reaches the paired predicates, and later {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) stacks a second emphasis onto the first predicate.

topics.headline: emphatic warrant clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause explains and grounds the text claim rather than starting an unrelated new topic.
topics.reason: The annulling particle opens the final nominal clause and shifts from textual predication to divine warrant.

topics.headline: scope over predicate sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the emphasis cover the whole knowledge-and-sight closure over servants.
topics.reason: The particle governs the divine name while the predicates complete the clause it opens.

topics.headline: stacked emphasis frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing warrant strengthened twice: first by the opening particle, then by the predicate lām.
topics.reason: The shaddah-bearing particle anticipates the later emphatic lām on the first predicate.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the emphatic clause subject
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name with worship/refuge orientation; local clause anchors the knowledge predicates in named divine agency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic opener of the final warrant clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) makes the final warrant explicit by naming the divine subject after {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}). The proper name carries the earlier implicit agency of {{ar:أَوْحَيْنَآ}} ({{tr:awḥaynā}}) into open naming, then takes stable nominal predicates rather than a momentary action. The worship-and-refuge derivational pressure remains relationally useful: servants and revelation are oriented before the named God, but the local grammar treats the word as the proper divine name, not an indefinite deity term. The named divine subject and His servants also form the mastery relation over which the knowledge predicates close.

topics.headline: explicit divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine agency become openly named in the warrant clause after being carried earlier by verb morphology.
topics.reason: The proper name is the accusative subject of the emphatic clause and anchors the paired predicates.

topics.headline: stable predicative attributes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees what Allah is in relation to servants, not a new single event performed on them.
topics.reason: The name is case-marked by the particle while the following predicates remain nominative attributes.

topics.headline: proper name not generic deity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps worship and refuge pressure near the name while recognizing that the local word functions as the proper divine name.
topics.reason: Derivational discussions may color the proper name, but the contracted surface and local grammar block an indefinite deity reading.

topics.headline: master-servants warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the named divine subject and His servants form the relational field over which the knowledge predicates close.
topics.reason: Rows connect the divine name with servants, Book, and the transition from 35:30 reward into 35:31 revelation-warrant, with parallels in 17:30 and 42:27.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition marking servants as the domain of divine knowledge and sight
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) binds the servants phrase into the predicate field. Because the prepositional phrase stands before {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}) {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}), the servants are foregrounded as the domain of both divine expertise and divine sight, not only of the first predicate. Its bound form makes that domain dependent from the first sound.

topics.headline: fronted servants domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the human domain placed before the attributes that close over it.
topics.reason: The bāʾ phrase governs the servants noun and is fronted before the paired predicates.

topics.headline: close concern and boundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels servants as the immediate field of divine concern and access, not a remote topic.
topics.reason: The bound preposition fuses with the servants noun and can mark close attachment, domain, or concern.

topics.headline: soft domain cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the domain phrase as a single governed unit before the predicates arrive.
topics.reason: The short preposition binds phonologically into the possessed servants phrase.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural servants as governed accountable domain
words.root_gloss_range: service, worship, subjection, and devotion; local noun selects Allah-related servants under audit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: bound preposition marking the servants domain
named divine subject of the warrant clause

words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihi}}) is genitive under {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and definite through the suffix, which resolves locally to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}). The servants are therefore not a new subject but the accountable domain placed before {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}) {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}). As a possessed plural bound to the preposition, the word compresses collective servant-class, divine ownership, and predicate domain. The root pressure of service, worship, and subjection makes the human field morally responsive to the revealed truth, and same-surah links carry these known servants toward Book inheritance in 35:32 and judgment in 35:45.

topics.headline: possessed servants domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the servants are already defined by relation to Allah before the knowledge predicates are named.
topics.reason: The genitive plural is governed by the bāʾ phrase and the suffix resolves to the named divine subject in the same clause.

topics.headline: accountable servitude field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees servants as accountable receivers and responders, not a neutral population label; the broader service and worship range is locally focused by the closing audit.
topics.reason: The root family supports service, worship, and subjection, while the possessed plural phrase is the domain of divine expertise and sight.

topics.headline: collective owned domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a collective servant-class compressed with divine possession and prepositional governance.
topics.reason: The broken plural, possessive suffix, and bound preposition compress human field, relation, and divine ownership.

topics.headline: fronted known-servants arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the human field under divine audit become the field of Book reception and inheritance.
topics.reason: Rows connect the fronted servants domain with 35:28, 35:32, and 35:45, and with provision or restraint formulas in 17:30 and 42:27.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām attached to the first predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic opener of the final warrant clause

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is emphatic lām on the first predicate, not a possession or purpose preposition. It concentrates the stress on {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}) as the entry point of the pair, while {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}) completes the sequence. Together with {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it gives the final warrant stacked assertion rather than bare predication.

topics.headline: predicate emphasis not preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle strengthens the predicate claim instead of introducing possession, purpose, or a new complement.
topics.reason: Its local attachment is to the first nominative predicate after the emphatic clause opener.

topics.headline: inward expertise stressed first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears inward expertise receive the first explicit stress before visible perception is added.
topics.reason: The lām attaches to the first predicate, making that predicate the stressed entry into the pair.

topics.headline: stacked pair emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final two-attribute closure heightened as a sequence, even though the lām is written on the first predicate.
topics.reason: The first predicate carries the lām, and the following predicate completes the emphasized pair within the same clause.

words.gloss_range: emphatic nominative predicate of experienced inward knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: report, information, tested experience, and expertise; local predicate selects settled divine expertise over servants
words.prose: {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}) is the first predicate of the emphatic clause and bears the added lām. It names Allah’s settled expertise over {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihi}}), not a new action performed on them. The root range of report, tested experience, and expertise makes the audit inward and acquainted; placed before {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}), it begins the hidden-to-visible closure over the servants who receive the revealed truth.

topics.headline: emphatic nominative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause stresses what Allah is toward servants, not a separate event of knowing.
topics.reason: The predicate remains nominative after the emphatic particle and carries the lām from the preceding split word.

topics.headline: inward expert knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the knowledge as experienced inward expertise over servants, not abstract omniscience language alone.
topics.reason: The root family includes report and tested experience, and the faʿīl predicate makes the quality stable in relation to servants.

topics.headline: servant formula redirected to revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a familiar servants-and-knowledge formula redirected toward the audience’s reception of revealed truth.
topics.reason: Parallels at 17:30 and 42:27 use the knowledge-sight formula around servants and provision; here it grounds revelation, truth, and confirmation.

topics.headline: hidden before visible cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closure move from inner conditions to visible realities with paired predicate cadence.
topics.reason: The local order places inward expertise before sight, and the matching endings make the pair sound like one closure formula.

words.gloss_range: second nominative predicate of perceptive sight and insight
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perception, and insight; local predicate completes the hidden-visible pair over servants
words.prose: {{ar:بَصِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:baṣīrun}}) follows {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}) without a conjunction, so the predicates accumulate tightly rather than forming two detachable claims. It adds perceptive sight and insight to inward expertise, completing the hidden-visible pair over {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihi}}). As the final word, it lands the ayah on divine perception: the reward promise of 35:30 and the revelation claim of 35:31 are grounded in comprehensive knowledge of the servants’ inward states and visible response. The echo field of 17:30 and 42:27 keeps that knowledge-sight formula tied to governance, provision, and accountability, here redirected toward revelation reception.

topics.headline: tight second predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second attribute attach immediately to the first, not as a separate coordinated clause.
topics.reason: There is no conjunction between the two nominative predicates, so the second accumulates with the first.

topics.headline: perceptive sight and insight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sight as discerning perception over servants’ outward realities, not a momentary visual act.
topics.reason: The root and faʿīl pattern support seeing, perception, and insight, narrowed locally to the second divine predicate over servants.

topics.headline: hidden-visible completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the close cover both hidden inward states and visible outward realities with no gap left between them.
topics.reason: The final clause combines emphatic assertion, fronted servants-domain, and the paired attributes of inward expertise and perceptive sight.

topics.headline: final audit closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah land on comprehensive divine audit, tying reward, revelation, and response together.
topics.reason: The final word completes the rhyme-like predicate pair and grounds 35:30’s promise as well as 35:31’s truth claim.

topics.headline: formula and governance echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the knowledge-sight formula over servants as a governance and accountability frame redirected here toward revelation reception.
topics.reason: Rows cite 17:30 and 42:27 for the servants formula in governance and provision settings, while local syntax applies it to response before revealed truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain at focus words 2, 5, 7-11 moves from imparting, to a written composition, to truth, and then to active confirmation of what stands before it.
baseline_models.mechanism: A privately delivered communication becomes a durable textual object whose reality is not isolated: its truth operates relationally by testing and affirming material already or immediately before it.

activation_trace.role: A concealed imparting of knowledge supplies the message's directed mode of arrival.
An ordered written composition supplies the durable object whose contents can be compared.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the emphatic predicate's claim.
Truthful correspondence supplies the active participle's verifying relation to another witness.
An interval between parties locates the confirmed material relationally rather than treating it as detached.
What stands in front or near supplies the idiom's spatial-temporal orientation.

changed_reading.before: A revealed book is simply declared true.
changed_reading.after: A directed communication takes durable textual form and demonstrates its truth through an active relation of verification with what already stands before it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 7, and 8 can be read through the decree, binding-due, and fulfillment branches of their roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book can function as an enacted determination, truth as what has become binding, and confirmation as making a prior word or promise effective. This yields a juridical-performative reading alongside the correspondence reading.

activation_trace.role: A recorded determination that imposes judgment or measure makes the Book an operative order, not only a document.
A fixed obligation or due supplies truth with binding force.
Making a promise, vision, or statement come true supplies confirmation with performative force.

changed_reading.after: Confirmation can also mean that the communicated decree makes an already binding claim or promise real in action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at focus words 10-11 literally orients the object of confirmation in front of, near, or prior to the Book.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial idiom leaves two temporal directions live: preceding material can stand before the new message in sequence, while an impending reality can stand before it as what is near to occur. Confirmation is therefore potentially retrospective and prospective.

activation_trace.role: The middle or interval preserves a relational field rather than fixing one temporal direction.
Frontness, precedence, and nearness keep both prior witness and impending event available.
Realization of a promise or vision permits confirmation to point toward fulfillment as well as backward agreement.

changed_reading.before: What is before the Book denotes only earlier texts.
changed_reading.after: The Book may face both inherited witness behind it and promised reality approaching before it, confirming across both directions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final construction at focus words 14-16 places the servants under paired divine expertise and sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge of inward circumstances and direct sight of outward conditions jointly underwrite the truth claim. The close is an epistemic warrant calibrated to persons, motives, and visible acts, not an ornamental pair of titles.

activation_trace.role: Submissive service supplies the human relation whose hidden fidelity and visible conduct are assessed.
Knowledge gained at the inward depth of a matter supplies access beyond appearance.
Direct visual perception supplies witness of exposed conditions and acts.
Penetrating discernment joins physical sight to informed judgment of the servants.

changed_reading.before: The closing titles merely generalize divine omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The closing pair warrants the revelation by encompassing both the servants' concealed interiors and their inspectable conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier assertion that God's promise is binding truth, framed against deception that gleams without holding, gives the focus truth a future edge. What stands before the Book can include an outcome not yet realized but already due.

activation_trace.role: Binding necessity lets the focus truth carry an obligation whose fulfillment may still be ahead.
What is in front or near provides the focus anchor for prospective confirmation.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the not-yet-realized object of truth.
The context explicitly couples promise with binding truth, transferring futurity into the focus predicate.
Deceptive shine without stability provides the foil that distinguishes durable promise from attractive appearance.

structural_cues: The same truth lexeme predicates a promise in 35:5 before predicating the revealed Book in 35:31.
The front-facing idiom in the focus does not grammatically force a past-only referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promise named truth, a deception contrast, and a front-facing focus idiom. I infer that promised fulfillment can be among what the Book verifies ahead of itself. A live alternative is that the idiom refers only to prior written revelation.

changed_reading.before: The Book confirms only an inherited textual past.
changed_reading.after: The Book also confirms a promised future: what is not yet visible can already stand before it as a binding truth rather than a deceptive prospect.

context_deltas.mechanism: A person can visually register an embellished evil as good, while the later context locates divine knowledge in the unseen and in the action-producing interior. The focus pairing of inward expertise and sight therefore names correction of mis-seeing, not redundant observation.

activation_trace.role: Inward expertise supplies access to the concealed condition that surface vision can miss.
Penetrating discernment supplies corrected judgment rather than bare optical registration.
Making something appear good supplies the mechanism by which a visible surface can mislead.
Eye or inner seeing supplies the human judgment that accepts the embellished surface.
The good-versus-ugly contrast supplies the mistaken value assigned by the viewer.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the domain that optical appearance cannot settle.
The inward source from which actions issue supplies the concealed origin known by divine expertise.

structural_cues: In 35:8 seeing and moral evaluation diverge: evil is seen as good.
In 35:38 unseen knowledge narrows to what is within breasts, after the focus has paired expertise with sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fallible human seeing, concealed interiors, and the focus's paired titles. I infer a corrective division of labor: expertise reaches the source while sight registers manifestation. A live alternative is that both titles simply intensify undifferentiated omniscience.

changed_reading.before: Divine sight means perfect observation of the same surfaces humans see.
changed_reading.after: The paired close exposes the insufficiency of surface vision: God sees the act while knowing the hidden production of the appearance and thus cannot be deceived by moral decoration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good word rises in company with fitting work, and the later sequence turns recitation of the Book into prayer, expenditure, and full payment. This makes confirmation an enacted correspondence in which conduct carries a word into realized truth.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment by deed supplies the focus participle with an enactment sense beyond verbal assent.
Meaningful speech linking speakers supplies the verbal element awaiting embodied verification.
Purposive action supplies the practical counterpart through which the good word becomes effective.
Elevation supplies the directional link by which speech and fitting action acquire acceptance or efficacy.
Following in sequence supplies recitation as an ongoing attachment to the Book rather than isolated utterance.
Sending wealth outward supplies the visible deed that follows recitation and prayer.
Completion without deficiency supplies the answering realization of the practiced word.

structural_cues: The subject of the raising verb in 35:10 is grammatically live, placing word and work in a deliberately tight causal relation.
The immediate 35:29-30 sequence runs from Book-recitation through embodied acts to completed recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ascending good word, fitting work, a raising verb, and recitation followed by acts and payment. I infer that work authenticates or carries the word into realization. A live alternative is that God raises the work or the word without making action the confirmer.

changed_reading.before: The Book confirms earlier words by matching their content.
changed_reading.after: The Book confirms by generating a word-to-work-to-fulfillment sequence; truth is recognized in enacted correspondence as well as textual agreement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same Book lexeme earlier contains the measured extension and reduction of lives. That recurrence allows the focus's source phrase to point not only to a bounded scripture but also to a comprehensive register or determination from which the revealed communication discloses ordered reality.

activation_trace.role: Directed imparting supplies disclosure from a source larger than the immediate utterance.
An established determination supplies the focus Book with a decree-register reading.
A register fixing life spans supplies the contextual instance that carries measured order back into the focus.

structural_cues: The same indefinite Book noun in 35:11 contains lifespan measures, while the focus says the revealed material is from the Book.
The source preposition in the focus permits a source or partitive relation without deciding it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated Book language and an earlier register of measured lives. I infer semantic carryback from register to the focus source. A live alternative is ordinary polysemy: the earlier record and the focus scripture may be distinct uses with no source relation.

changed_reading.before: The source is exclusively a previously bounded written scripture.
changed_reading.after: The revealed Book can also be heard as disclosure from a comprehensive determination in which temporal lives and realities are already inscribed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two unequal waters can remain different while each yields benefit, and previous messengers arrive through several named media of disclosure. Read as an analogy, this prevents confirmation from collapsing witnesses into sameness: distinct forms can remain distinct while participating in one truth-bearing economy.

activation_trace.role: Correspondence to truth supplies relation without requiring formal identity.
A connection maintained between parties supplies continuity across their distinction.
Equality as the explicitly negated comparison supplies a model in which shared yield does not erase difference.
Plural message-bearers supply the historical continuity of transmission.
Manifest evidence supplies one mode by which earlier messages become testable.
A distinct written-scripture medium supplies plurality within the inherited witness.
The named written composition supplies another durable medium beside signs and prior writings.
Illumination supplies the shared disclosure function across the distinct media.

structural_cues: In 35:12 the two waters are expressly unequal, yet the continuation attributes useful yield to each.
In 35:25 signs, writings, and an illuminating Book remain separately named in one messenger sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal yet useful waters and plural disclosure media. I infer an analogy: confirmation can preserve difference while recognizing shared truth-bearing function. A live alternative is that the water comparison concerns creation alone and should not govern textual relations.

changed_reading.before: To confirm earlier material is to reproduce or homogenize it.
changed_reading.after: Confirmation may preserve nonidentity: different witnesses and media can remain unlike while the new Book recognizes and illuminates their truthful yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier claim that no informant compares with an expert turns the focus's closing epithet into a source credential. The One who imparts the Book knows the interior of the reported matter and also directly witnesses the servants to whom it speaks.

activation_trace.role: Hidden but directed communication creates the need to establish the communicator's competence.
Knowledge of reports and inward realities supplies the source's epistemic qualification.
Direct sight supplies witness in addition to reported expertise.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the explicit informational frame.
The incomparable knower of a matter's interior supplies the standard for trustworthy informing.

structural_cues: In 35:14 the expert epithet is syntactically tied to the act of informing.
The same epithet closes the focus immediately after revelation, truth, and confirmation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit expert-informant construction and repeats the expert title after the focus communication claim. I infer that the close retroactively authenticates the source. A live alternative is that it only asserts incomparable general knowledge without functioning as a provenance argument.

changed_reading.before: The final titles are a general devotional close after the truth claim.
changed_reading.after: The final titles are part of the truth mechanism: the communication is credible because its source has inward expertise and direct sight unmatched by any informant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence distinguishes blind from seeing, hearing from being made to hear, and truthful sending from actual guidance. The later arrival of a warner can even increase flight. The focus Book's truth and confirming function therefore do not mechanically determine reception.

activation_trace.role: Truth fixed against falsehood lets validity remain stable when reception fails.
Inner discernment supplies the recipient capacity that cannot be reduced to message availability.
Blindness of inner perception supplies a mode of failed uptake despite an available contrast.
Discernment supplies the contrasting receptive state.
Causing another to hear supplies the disputed efficacy that exceeds mere speaking.
The messenger and message relation supplies a valid delivery regardless of response.
Sending with stable truth directly separates message validity from audience acceptance.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the intended effect without guaranteeing that effect.
Gentle direction toward a true path supplies the guidance the audience had claimed it would accept.
Increase supplies the reversal in which arrival amplifies the opposite response.
Pulling away from the message supplies the realized response that contradicts the prior claim.

structural_cues: The contrast chain in 35:19-22 separates exposure, perception, life, and effective hearing.
In 35:42 the arrival of the requested warner produces an increase, but the increase is in aversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a truthful sending, differentiated perceptual capacities, and a warner whose arrival increases flight. I infer that truth and confirmation do not causally compel assent. A live alternative is that these verses console the messenger without qualifying the focus's confirming action.

changed_reading.before: A truth-confirming Book should transparently produce recognition in anyone who encounters it.
changed_reading.after: The Book remains true and confirming while reception branches: the same arrival can awaken discernment or intensify aversion, so rejection does not falsify the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local sequence moves from servants reciting the Book, through revelation and divine scrutiny, to the Book's transfer as an inheritance among chosen servants who occupy three unequal moral positions. The focus becomes a hinge from authenticated transmission to risky, differentiated custody.

activation_trace.role: The durable written composition supplies the object capable of passing into human custody.
Servants in a relation of submissive service supply the human group addressed by divine scrutiny.
Knowledge of inward conditions allows stewardship to be assessed beneath broad group membership.
Direct sight supplies oversight of how the inherited Book is actually carried.
Following the Book in recited sequence supplies one lived mode of custody before the focus.
The recited written composition supplies the pre-focus human engagement with the same object.
Transmission of knowledge or a book as inheritance supplies the post-focus transfer into communal custody.
The same written object supplies continuity across revelation, recitation, and inheritance.
Selection of a chosen group supplies privilege without erasing variation within that group.
The repeated servants relation explicitly links the focus close to the inheriting community.
A middle position between extremes supplies one nonuniform mode of carrying the inheritance.
Advancing ahead in a race supplies the foremost mode alongside moderate and self-wronging custody.

structural_cues: The local order is reciting Book in 35:29, revealed Book in 35:31, and inherited Book in 35:32.
The servants phrase at the focus close recurs in 35:32 immediately before a threefold internal differentiation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated Book and servants expressions plus the reveal-to-inherit sequence. I infer that the focus close anticipates oversight of morally mixed stewardship. A live alternative is that the focus speaks of all servants generally and the next verse begins an independent classification.

changed_reading.before: The verse ends once the Book's external authenticity is established.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a hinge: authenticated revelation becomes an inherited trust carried unevenly by chosen servants, and the closing expertise and sight make room for that internal differentiation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later challenge asks whether rival authorities received a Book from which they stand on manifest evidence, then contrasts that absent grant with mutually circulated deceptive promises. This makes the focus Book an authorized evidentiary source whose confirming force differs from self-validating assertion.

activation_trace.role: A durable written composition supplies the document from which warranted evidence can proceed.
Establishing and displaying truth through evidence supplies the focus predicate's demonstrative force.
Correspondence between claim and reality supplies the test that authorized evidence passes.
A granted written document supplies the missing warrant demanded of rival claims.
Manifest disclosure supplies the evidentiary footing that a genuine Book could confer.
Mutual promise supplies the rival speech-act that claims a future without authoritative grounding.
Shimmering deception without stability supplies the diagnosis of the unsupported promise.

structural_cues: The later question uses a Book-to-evidence source construction and denies that grant to the rivals.
The adversative turn replaces documentary evidence with wrongdoers promising one another deception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a granted Book as possible evidentiary footing and contrasts its absence with deceptive promises. I infer that the focus Book's confirmation is authorized evidence, not circular self-assertion. A live alternative is that 35:40 only attacks rival worship and does not specify the focus Book's epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Book is true because the verse labels it true.
changed_reading.after: The Book occupies an authorized evidentiary position: it can disclose a clear footing and verify other witnesses, unlike unsupported promises that circulate only between claimants.

context_deltas.mechanism: An invariant path is followed by a command to travel, look, and inspect predecessors' outcomes. This extends what stands before the Book from earlier wording to visible historical residue: the Book confirms a recurring pattern that can be encountered in the world.

activation_trace.role: Realization in events supplies confirmation as historical fulfillment rather than only verbal agreement.
The relational space before the Book permits an encountered historical field.
What is in front and near supplies the anchor for remains and outcomes placed before observers.
A running path repeatedly followed supplies the stable historical pattern.
One thing replacing another supplies the substitution explicitly denied of the pattern.
Change from one condition to another supplies the transformation explicitly denied of the pattern.
Moving through the land supplies physical access to the historical witness.
Directing sight and insight supplies the act by which the witness is inspected.
The final consequence of a course supplies the observable result that confirms the pattern.

structural_cues: The no-substitution and no-transformation formulas are followed immediately by travel and visual inspection.
The inspected people are explicitly those from before, echoing the focus's front-prior idiom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invariant historical path and a command to inspect predecessors' outcomes. I infer that visible history can join earlier texts among what the Book confirms. A live alternative is that the focus object remains exclusively prior revelation and history is only later corroboration.

changed_reading.before: The object confirmed is a corpus of earlier statements.
changed_reading.after: The Book also confirms an embodied historical pattern: predecessors' outcomes stand before observers as visible realization of the truth it announces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah-final echo repeats divine sight of the servants inside a sentence about earned acts, delayed taking, and an appointed term. That echo gives the focus sight a temporal mode: complete observation can coexist with restraint and deferred reckoning.

activation_trace.role: The servants relation supplies the repeated object of sustained divine oversight.
Direct sight supplies complete awareness without itself specifying immediate intervention.
Acquired results of action supply the conduct already visible and answerable.
A fixed limit of time supplies the interval during which observed accountability is deferred.
The repeated servants relation binds the final temporal scene back to the focus close.
The repeated sight epithet closes the delay scene with uninterrupted observation.

structural_cues: The final verse nearly repeats the focus's servants-and-sight close while omitting the expertise epithet.
The repeated phrase follows explicit non-immediate taking and delay to a named term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact thematic echo of servants and sight within delayed accountability. I infer that the focus sight is patient temporal governance, not a claim that seeing entails instant punishment. A live alternative is that the final echo merely reiterates general omniscience after an unrelated delay clause.

changed_reading.before: Being seen by God implies immediate exposure and response.
changed_reading.after: Divine sight is continuous across delay: servants' acts are fully observed while judgment is deliberately held to an appointed term.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a meteorological transport chain onto revelation; it remains anchored in the focus's directed imparting and written message, and the context supplies sending, driving, dead ground, revivification, and rising. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for communicative efficacy, not as a lexical equation between Book and rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 2 and 5 describe something directed to the addressee from the Book, allowing the delivered message to be viewed as a carried medium.

activation_trace.role: Directed hidden imparting supplies the delivery process to which the material analogy attaches.
The written message supplies the content carried through that process.
Dispatch and movement outward supply the first stage of the transport chain.
Driving a carried body toward a destination supplies directed delivery to a recipient.
Lifeless land supplies the initially unreceptive substrate reached by the delivery.
Earth revived through water and growth supplies the changed state caused by reception.
Rising after death supplies the maximal outcome toward which the delivery analogy points.

changed_reading.before: Revelation is transfer of information to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, revelation is a routed, life-bearing delivery whose truth becomes legible in the recipient's transition from inertness to responsive life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates account, due, charity, and immediate-settlement senses inside a theological sentence; it remains anchored in the focus roots for Book, truth, confirmation, and hand, while 35:29-30 supplies expenditure, non-failing trade, and full payment. Downstream prose should mark it as an economic-juridical analogy, not translate the focus participle as an alms collector.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 7, 8, and 11 can jointly support a register, a valid claim, financial truthfulness, and hand-to-hand settlement.

activation_trace.role: A binding recorded determination supplies the account or ledger frame.
A claim held by its owner supplies what the ledger recognizes as due.
Giving wealth as a truthful due supplies a distant but anchored financial activation of confirmation.
Immediate hand-to-hand exchange supplies settlement rather than indefinite credit.
Wealth leaving possession supplies the debit or expenditure enacted by the readers.
Trade seeking return supplies the explicit economic frame around engagement with the Book.
Market stagnation ending in loss supplies the failure explicitly denied of this trade.
Full completion without shortfall supplies final settlement of what is due.

changed_reading.before: The Book verifies prior information in an abstract epistemic relation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained economic analogy, the Book is a binding account that recognizes valid claims, records truthful expenditure, and carries the promised exchange through to full settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines rare material branches for joining, tight construction, and stitched edges with cosmic holding; it remains anchored in four focus lexemes and is activated by 35:41's holding-versus-dislocation contrast. Downstream prose should call it a tactile coherence model, never a lexical translation or a claim that the verse literally describes cosmological fabric.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 7, 10, and 16 admit material images of joining, tight construction, connective interval, and sewn edges.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the Book as an assembled coherence.
Tight construction in cloth or speech supplies truth as structural soundness.
A connector maintained between sides supplies the relational joint.
Stitching two pieces along a substantial edge supplies the outlier's tactile joining image.
Holding and restraining supplies the force that preserves an assembled order.
Displacement from place or state supplies the disintegration that holding prevents.

changed_reading.before: Truth is only correct semantic content.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained material model, the truth-confirming Book is an assembled joint whose coherent relations hold disparate witnesses together against displacement.

strongest_changes: The close functions as an expert-source credential and as correction of deceptive appearance, not merely as a generic title pair.
Confirmation becomes performative: recited word, fitting work, expenditure, and completed payment form an enactment chain.
The focus is a hinge from revelation to inherited, morally mixed stewardship among the servants named on both sides of the hinge.
Truth and confirmation remain valid without compelling uptake; arrival can produce discernment or increased aversion.
The final servants-and-sight echo recasts divine seeing as continuous oversight compatible with deliberate delay.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly turns apparently static nouns into processes: Book becomes register, evidence, recited practice, and inheritance; confirmation becomes fulfillment; sight becomes correction and patient oversight. It also keeps retrospective textual confirmation, prospective promise, and visible historical corroboration simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: The front-facing idiom does not decide whether prospective fulfillment genuinely belongs to its referent or is only a contextual resonance.
The register reading of Book depends on semantic carryback from 35:11 and may remain distinct from scripture in the focus.
The unequal-waters analogy supports confirmation without identity, but its transfer from creation to textual media is exploratory.
The subject-object relation of the raising verb in 35:10 leaves several action-word causal directions grammatically live.
The three material outliers are mechanistically anchored but should never displace the stronger communicative, evidentiary, and stewardship readings.

baseline.text: Kitaptan sana vahyettiğimiz, kendinden öncekileri doğrulayan gerçeğin ta kendisidir. Allah kullarından elbette haberdardır, onları görür.

findings.text: Gizli biçimde iletilen vahiy, önceki yazıyı doğrulayan kamusal ve sınanabilir bir bağa dönüşerek aktarımda kopuş değil süreklilik kurar.
Kitabın önündekileri doğrulaması, geçmiş metinlere yalnız bakmasını değil, onların önceki yetkisini devralıp ileri taşımasını da anlatır.
Allah'ın içten haberdar oluşu ve görmesi, kitabın emanet edileceği taşıyıcıların hem içini hem dışını kapsayan bir değerlendirme sağlar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A truthful communication is fixed as a transmissible text, handed on as an inheritance, and entrusted to a differentiated body of recipients.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The transfer can be read simultaneously as inscription, gratuitous grant, succession, and a graded movement in which restraint and precedence are distinct responses to the same trust.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hidden communication made durable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Knowledge is delivered through a hidden communicative act, fixed in writing, and authenticated by correspondence with an already established truth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hidden delivery of knowledge (quranic:root_001633:B001/m01); writing or inscription (quranic:root_001633:B003/m01); divine revelation (quranic:root_001633:B004/m01); written book (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); truth as stable correspondence (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); truthfulness in report (quranic:root_000852:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:31 `أَوْحَيْ/كِتَٰبِ/حَقُّ/مُصَدِّقًا` (و ح ي/ك ت ب/ح ق ق/ص د ق).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Revelation is not left as an inward event. Its hidden delivery becomes publicly durable as writing, while confirmation tests that writing against a truth relation rather than against novelty alone.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A truthful communication is fixed as a transmissible text, handed on as an inheritance, and entrusted to a differentiated body of recipients.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The transfer can be read simultaneously as inscription, gratuitous grant, succession, and a graded movement in which restraint and precedence are distinct responses to the same trust.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inheritance, register, and succession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A predecessor's possession or knowledge passes to successors, is entered into a durable register, and becomes a trust held in the place of those before them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inheritance from a predecessor (quranic:root_001639:B001/m01); grant without purchase or contract (quranic:root_001639:B002/m01); inheritance of knowledge or scripture (quranic:root_001639:B003/m01); written register (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); succession or replacement (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); what is already present or preceding (quranic:root_001693:B008/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The Book is both property passed on and knowledge placed in custody. The register supplies durability, succession supplies office, and the gratuitous grant excludes acquisition as the basis of authority.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is hidden within or beyond ordinary perception remains fully knowable and can be brought into evidentiary view.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes concealment, inward source, visual reception, insight, and public manifestation instead of treating knowledge and sight as interchangeable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Concealed source and inward content
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A content is withheld from ordinary eyes, lodged in the chest or heart as a source of action, yet remains available to complete knowledge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: concealment from sight (quranic:root_001117:B001/m01); chest as inner enclosure (quranic:root_000849:B001/m01); chest as source of outward acts (quranic:root_000849:B004/m01); hidden heart or inward core (quranic:root_000266:B010/m01); knowledge of inner conditions (quranic:root_000387:B001/m01); comprehensive knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hiddenness is a limit on ordinary reception, not on knowability. Chest, heart, and inner condition locate the source from which action issues, making later judgment responsive to concealed formation as well as visible deed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is hidden within or beyond ordinary perception remains fully knowable and can be brought into evidentiary view.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes concealment, inward source, visual reception, insight, and public manifestation instead of treating knowledge and sight as interchangeable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sight, insight, and evidentiary showing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Eyes receive an object, reflection converts reception into insight, and a claimant is required to bring the alleged object into manifest view.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visual perception (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); inward discernment or insight (quranic:root_000121:B002/m01); causing something to be seen (quranic:root_000531:B012/m01); reflective looking (quranic:root_001520:B001/m01); emergence into view (quranic:root_000970:B001/m01); manifestation as proof (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Seeing is partitioned into reception, reflective interpretation, and demonstrative showing. The demand to show what partners created therefore exposes a failure of evidence, not merely a failure to look.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Ordered space persists because a capable agent restrains its parts from displacement and cannot be defeated by any competing force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Holding, instability, escape, hand-power, and cord-like strength materialize cosmic order as an ongoing exertion rather than a static arrangement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Power is sufficient to execute an intended act, while any object that might resist or flee fails to escape its reach.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: effective capacity to act (quranic:root_001205:B003/m01); strength like joined cord strands (quranic:root_001274:B001/m01); inability or incapacitation (quranic:root_000985:B001/m01); escape beyond another's reach (quranic:root_000985:B002/m01); hand as operative power (quranic:root_001693:B002/m01); bodily or structural strength (quranic:root_000782:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:31 `يَدَيْ` (ي د ي); 35:44 `يُعْجِزَ/قَدِيرًا/قُوَّةً/أَشَدَّ` (ع ج ز/ق د ر/ق و ي/ش د د).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Capacity is measured by successful execution, not by an abstract attribute. The failed-escape sense of inability places the opposing object inside the same reach that performs cosmic restraint.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A maximally strengthened pledge creates an obligation of receptivity, but the arrival of its promised warning can still disclose withdrawal rather than guidance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Divine naming, life-stakes adjuration, arrival, and bodily recoil expose the distance between verbal commitment and enacted response.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Strengthened pledge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speakers invoke the divine name and bind themselves with their strongest oath, treating the pledge as an obligation that must later be discharged.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: oath as binding speech (quranic:root_001226:B004/m01); oath used for confirmation (quranic:root_001698:B003/m01); divine name invoked in oath (quranic:root_000047:B002/m01); adjuration by life (quranic:root_001044:B002/m01); discharging a sworn obligation (quranic:root_000351:B005/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The oath is a speech act with maximal force, not evidence of later compliance. Invoked name, life-stakes force, and discharge sharpen the subsequent failure by specifying what the speakers claimed to bind.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hızlı olma, acele etme, birini hızlandırma, acele çağrısı, hızlı şey ve hızlı yapılan kesme eylemini birlikte verir; dal çerçevesi bu hız kümesini doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gizli bildirim veya ses değil, hız niteliği ile hızlandırma ve acele ettirme kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel hız çekirdeği korunur; acele çağrıları, birini hızlandırma, hızlı ölüm ve hızlı kesim gibi kalıp ya da yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Hızlı olma veya hızlı davranma, birini hızlandırma ya da aceleye çağırma alanıdır. Hızlı bir şey, çabuk gelen ölüm ve hızla yapılan kesim de buna bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık, iş veya davranış hızlıdır ya da hızla gerçekleşir.
Bir başkasının işi hızlandırılır veya kişi acele etmeye yöneltilir.
Tekrarlanan bir söz veya buyruk, hemen davranma çağrısı yapar.
Ölümün çabuk gelmesi ve hayvanın hızla kesilmesi belirtilmiş örneklerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hız ve acele çekirdeğinde birleşir; niteleme, buyurma, başkasını hızlandırma ve hızlı yapılan özel eylem bu çekirdeğin farklı dil bilgisel gerçekleşmeleridir.

error_profile.preserves: Hız niteliğini, hızlı eylemi ve hızlandırma ilişkisini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Hızlı olma niteliğini kısa ve doğal biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye hemen davranmasını söyleyen buyruk ve tekrar bağlamlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hemen davranma yönündeki acele çağrısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir başkasını veya onun işini daha çabuk gerçekleşmeye yönelten kullanımlardadır.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen hız ilişkisini ve etkilenen katılımcıyı korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı türemiş yapı çevresinde yardım için seslenme, bilgi sorma ve köpeği salmak üzere çağırma kullanımlarını verir. Bunlar istek ortaklığıyla gruplanabilir, fakat tek bir eylem gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız yapıya bağlı üç istek kullanımını kapsar; genel sorma, çağırma veya gizli bildirme anlamına genişlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yardım isteme, bilgi sorma ve köpeği salmak için çağırma ayrı yapılara bağlı anlamlar olarak korunur; bunlardan genel bir yalın kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda yardım için seslenmek, birine sorarak bilgi istemek veya köpeği salmak amacıyla çağırmaktır. Üç kullanımın ortak yanı bir karşılık ya da hareket istemesidir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğa yardım istemek için seslenilir.
Bir kişiye soru yöneltilerek bilgi istenir.
Bir köpek, ardından salınması amacıyla çağrılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birlikte sunduğu alan, karşı taraftan yardım, bilgi veya hareket istemeye yarayan üç ayrı yapıdır; her kullanım kendi katılımcı ve amacıyla korunmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal tek bir kavram değildir: hükümdar olma, yönetimde zulmetme, hükümdar adı ve ateş adı ayrıştırılmalıdır. Yarar ve zarar verme bakımından kurulan hükümdar-ateş benzetmesi yalnız son iki kaydı ilişkilendirir.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin yoksulluktan sonra hükümdar olması ayrı bir eylem kaydıdır.

Hükümdar ve ateş ayrı adlandırmalardır; yarar ve zarar verme benzetmesi aralarında bağ kurar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlam çekirdeğini bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp birleştirmek olarak açıkça kurar; deri dikme, hayvanın bazı uzuvlarını bağlama, boncukla tutturma ve birlik oluşturma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğin özelleşmiş gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı yazma ya da hüküm verme anlamını değil, fiziksel veya toplu birleştirme işlemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak birleştirme çekirdeğini korur; dikme, bağlama, kapatma ve birlik düzenleme anlamlarını yalnızca tanıklanmış biçim ve yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, katma ve birleştirme çekirdeğinin dikiş, bağlama, sıkıca kapatma ve düzenli topluluk oluşturma gibi somut uygulamalarda korunmasıdır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri parçalarının veya su tulumunun dikişle bir araya getirildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dikiş aracılığıyla gerçekleştirilen birleştirme işlemini tam olarak korur.
